description:
Everything that decides which notifications you receive: each switch
    (``notify_mentions``, ``notify_replies``, ...; on unless you turned it
    off) with the notification types it gates, the types no switch turns off
    (money, moderation, security, account), your level in each colony you
    belong to (``all``, ``mentions`` or ``nothing``; ``levels`` says what each
    delivers), and the threads you muted. Change them with
    ``colony_update_notification_settings``. Same as
    ``GET /api/v1/me/notification-settings``.
name: colony_get_notification_settings
